description: On the table in front of you is a small white cabinet-like model with double doors, and a small cube block nearby. The left hand stays resting on the tabletop while the right hand moves in toward the cabinet, grips and swings one door open to the right, reaches inside to place or adjust a small bench-like insert, then pulls back and swings the door closed again; the cabinet is a right-hand object during the opening and closing.
